nodes.label: Drafting rules — long-form writing guidance
nodes.rationale: Adapted from AutoResearchClaw stage-17/19 prompt banks. Rules encoding a NeurIPS/ICML conference norm rather than a general writing principle are marked [venue-specific] and must be checked against 00_marking_criteria.md before being applied to PRJ93.

nodes.label: Evidence bounding — the full rule set (rules 1-6)
nodes.rationale: Titles may claim only what the tested conditions' numbers show; partial coverage takes 'Toward…' / 'Investigating…' framing. A single scalar with no condition labels supports no comparative claim. Never approximate a number from memory — if it is not in a result file it does not go in the text.

nodes.label: Statistical reporting rules (7-14)
nodes.rationale: 95% CIs on every table; p-values on every comparison with explicit non-significance wording; effect size alongside significance because a significant negligible difference is a finding about sample size, not method; both conditional and unconditional metrics where runs failed, since without both comparative claims are survivorship-biased; per-regime tables because aggregate-only results cannot support a robustness claim.

nodes.label: Method and setup reimplementability rules (15-21)
nodes.rationale: A baseline reported without stated tuning effort is a strawman and will be read as one. Generic labels (baseline_1, variant_2) make a results section uninterpretable. Evaluation metrics must be defined including the denominator, and preprocessing detailed enough to reproduce the input, not merely the model.

nodes.label: Structure and length rules (22-26)
nodes.rationale: Limitations in one 200-400 word section stating each point once, because repeating 'due to computational constraints' across sections reads as evasion. Roughly 80% of the text covers what was done and found. No body section dwarfing the others by more than ~3x; a results section shorter than related work signals a thin contribution.

nodes.label: Prose quality rules (27-30)
nodes.rationale: Hedging added during revision usually signals the reviser doubted a claim but did not check it — check it instead. Verb strength maps to evidence: 'demonstrates' needs significance across conditions, 'suggests' fits one condition, 'is consistent with' fits a non-significant trend. Introduction, discussion and conclusion must motivate, interpret and situate respectively rather than restate.

nodes.label: Citation practice rules (31-34)
nodes.rationale: Cite the originating paper, not a survey or later user. Citations clustered at the front signal that related work was written separately from the contribution. Reference-count targets (25-40, 15 in related work) are venue-specific and must be checked against 00_marking_criteria.md.

nodes.label: Figures and tables rules (35-38)
nodes.rationale: An unreferenced figure is a figure the examiner does not know why they are looking at. Per PRJ93_RULES.md a plain table is a defect unless the precise values matter more than the comparison. Never a placeholder in a cell — write N/A or drop the row.

nodes.label: Revision-specific rules (39-43)
nodes.rationale: A revision pass is targeted repair, not a rewrite: sections with no critique findings are copied verbatim, because rewriting untouched sections is how content and citations get silently lost. Abstract numbers must match the results section exactly, and an analysis that was not run is stated as not conducted rather than synthesised.
